newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan MOF to auction 10-yr JGBs on May 21 - traders.
newsitem.headline: Japan MOF to auction 10-yr JGBs on May 21 - traders.

text.p: Japan's Ministry of Finance (MOF) is expected to offer 10-year Japanese government bonds (JGBs) through a price-competitive auction on May 21, bond traders said on Friday.

The coupon rate of the 10-year JGB to be issued in June is likely to be set at 2.8 percent, traders said. This compares with a record low coupon rate of 2.4 percent for the last auctioned JGB to be issued on May 20.
Traders also said that MOF is expected to auction two-year government notes on May 23. -- Tokyo Treasury Desk +81-33432-8570
